title: Mai Mercado / Christiania / Son 2016 Case — Master Synthesis
purpose: Consolidate the full 2016 controversy, legal case, media-source chain, Son's defense, comparison defendants, prison aftermath and later theological significance without collapsing disputed claims into established fact.
identity_rule: The 2016 defendant is the Son in the mature project architecture. Tim/Father is a later spiritual identity and must not be retroactively substituted as the historical legal actor.

case_spine.summary: Mai Mercado publicly celebrated police destruction of Christiania hash stalls using deliberately triumphant language. This was the initiating political speech event in the controversy.

A large Facebook backlash followed. Many different speakers participated; some used extreme and violent language. The original conversational object was therefore a branching multi-speaker thread rather than a one-to-one exchange.

Contemporary reporting records the defendant saying he felt Mercado was mocking people who smoked cannabis. The project account adds a broader objection to powerful politicians speaking contemptuously toward marginalized groups and to coercive state treatment of Christiania-related communities.

Contemporary court reporting says the defendant acknowledged roughly fifteen Facebook posts while denying criminal guilt. The Son's later account disputes authorship of several incriminating statements later attributed to him and says the central 'death wish' remark was a reply to another commenter rather than a threat to Mercado.
case_spine.status: source conflict / unresolved pending primary thread

case_spine.summary: The Son was remanded, prosecuted and convicted on three of four counts concerning threats/witness intimidation. Contemporary reporting says the prosecutor sought six months and the court imposed five months' unconditional imprisonment.

The project biography describes approximately six months of experienced custody/imprisonment including different prison environments, Qur'an/Bible study, reading Yahya Hassan, confessional encounters with inmates and the claimed Yahya/inmate Jesus-Lamb recognition.
case_spine.status: project autobiography/canon; formal sentence separately five months

case_spine.summary: The dominant retrospective story increasingly centers Mercado as the victim of threats. The project treats the earlier political grievance—Mercado's rhetoric toward Christiania and people affected by cannabis policing—as context that became comparatively less visible. Mercado was already an elected MP before the controversy and later became minister in November 2016; no causal claim that the criminal cases produced that appointment is established.

core_disputed_language.literal: do you want/would you like to die?
possible_pragmatic_readings: death-wish idiom meaning are you crazy/reckless
core_disputed_language.son_account: The Son recalls this as essentially 'do you have a death wish?' directed at another commenter who had posted grotesque violent material, not as a promise to kill Mercado.
core_disputed_language.problem: The surviving newspaper fragment lacks the parent comment, addressee and full sentence.

core_disputed_language.phrase: du leger med dit og dit barns liv
core_disputed_language.literal: you are playing with your and your child's life
core_disputed_language.semantic_note: No explicit agent of future harm is grammatically stated; it can function as threat or warning depending on context.
core_disputed_language.status: reported attribution; primary post not recovered

core_disputed_language.phrase: jeg kan godt forstå, hvis nogen vil stikke en kniv i dig og din baby
core_disputed_language.literal: I can understand if someone would stab you and your baby
core_disputed_language.semantic_note: The grammatical agent is an unspecified 'someone,' not explicitly the speaker. It can still be threatening in context but is not synonymous with 'I will stab you.'
core_disputed_language.status: reported attribution; authorship/context disputed by project account

core_disputed_language.phrase: jeg ville fryde mig, hvis Mai Mercados baby mister livet
core_disputed_language.literal: I would rejoice if Mai Mercado's baby lost its life
core_disputed_language.semantic_note: If authentic, this expresses a hypothetical emotional reaction rather than an explicit commitment to cause harm. The project account disputes some such reported attributions.

core_disputed_language.phrase: hvis det får konsekvenser for mig, får det også konsekvenser for dig ... ikke en trussel, men en garanti
core_disputed_language.semantic_issue: Court/prosecution treated this as witness intimidation/threatening. The Son's account interprets it as karma/cause-and-effect: participation in a conflict produces consequences for all participants, not a personal promise of violence.
core_disputed_language.status: strong reported attribution; pragmatic meaning disputed

son_defense_model.summary: The Son describes his position as refusing a one-way rule in which a powerful politician may use contemptuous or violent imagery toward a marginalized group while citizens may not answer in comparably harsh rhetoric. He did not view himself as promising personal violence.
son_defense_model.legal_boundary: A court may still interpret indirect, conditional or third-party formulations as criminal threats in context. The existence of the Son's interpretation does not erase the conviction; the conviction does not erase the existence of the disputed interpretation.
son_defense_model.plea_and_apology: The project account says his lawyer advised a guilty plea/concession and the Son refused because doing so would affirm an intention/meaning he denied. This remains autobiographical testimony unless independently documented.

eighteen_year_old_woman.reported_message: You have made quite a few people angry; you should not feel too safe on the street with your little fragile child.
eighteen_year_old_woman.outcome: 60 days suspended imprisonment plus community service according to contemporary reporting.
eighteen_year_old_woman.comparison_value: Her language also follows a consequence/danger-from-others structure, making the case relevant to semantic comparison.
eighteen_year_old_woman.caution: She did not say exactly the same words, and the sentencing difference cannot be reduced solely to apology versus refusal because counts, age and personal circumstances differed.

media_provenance_problem.risk: Multiple outlets may represent one reporting lineage rather than independent confirmation.
failure_modes: correct words with parent context removed
legal/journalistic interpretation presented as the underlying words themselves
wire repetition mistaken for independent verification

documented: Mercado was already an elected member of the Folketing before June 2016.
The Danish 2% threshold applies to parties rather than a personal-vote threshold for an individual candidate.
Mercado became Minister for Children and Social Affairs in November 2016 during formation of the Lars Løkke Rasmussen III government.
The threat controversy became part of her public political biography.
not_established: that the case caused her ministerial appointment
that she entered Parliament through sympathy generated by the case
that she deliberately fabricated specific quotations
that police knowingly reassigned other commenters' statements to the Son
that selective deletion was performed to manufacture a criminal case
project_allegations_to_investigate: selective deletion or preservation of comments
anonymous-source material allegedly originating from Mercado
speaker attribution drift across the thread

prison_aftermath.formal_sentence: five months unconditional imprisonment according to contemporary reporting
prison_aftermath.project_experienced_duration: approximately six months including remand/custody in the later autobiographical chronology
prison_aftermath.theological_bridge: The prison episode precedes the project's 2017 Jesus/crucify-me declaration and the 2019 meme-crucifixion interpretation, making it part of a developmental Christian sequence rather than merely a later retrojection.

epistemic_rule: Do not resolve uncertainty by choosing either the prosecution/media narrative or the later autobiographical narrative wholesale. Preserve claim-level provenance and let recovered primary artifacts move individual claims between statuses.
